description: This is a Java source file defining an abstract class 'ModelScreenWidget' and multiple nested subclasses, representing different components and structures of a screen/widget modeling system in an OFBiz-based application. The classes include UI components such as sections, containers, labels, forms, screenlets, separators, includes, and platform-specific configurations, primarily used for rendering and modeling user interface layouts.

classes.name: ModelScreenWidget
classes.description: Abstract base class for all screen widget components, providing rendering interface and common structure for UI components in a model-driven screen system.

classes.name: SectionsRenderer
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering multiple sections of a screen, maintaining a map of section names to widgets, and rendering specific sections upon request.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a screen section, including conditional rendering, actions, sub-widgets, and fail-widgets, with logic to render itself based on conditions.

classes.name: ColumnContainer
classes.description: Represents a container of columns in the screen layout, handling ID and style expansion, and rendering of column layout.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a single column within a ColumnContainer, containing sub-widgets with expandable attributes.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: A generic container widget that can contain sub-widgets, with attributes for ID, type, style, auto-update features, and rendering logic.

classes.name: Screenlet
classes.description: A widget component representing a screen fragment that can be collapsible, with navigation menus, forms, and sub-widgets, supporting user preferences.

classes.name: HorizontalSeparator
classes.description: Represents a horizontal separator element with styling, used for dividing UI sections.

classes.name: IncludeScreen
classes.description: Includes another screen by name and location, with support for scope sharing.

classes.name: DecoratorScreen
classes.description: Wraps a screen with decorator sections and supports rendering of nested decorators.

classes.name: DecoratorSection
classes.description: A section within a decorator, containing sub-widgets to render.

classes.name: DecoratorSectionInclude
classes.description: Includes a specific decorator section, rendering pre-rendered content or delegating to nested sections.

classes.name: Label
classes.description: Text label widget with support for dynamic text, ID, and style expansion.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: Represents an included form component, with expansion for name, location, and scope sharing, supporting rendering via form renderer.

classes.name: Grid
classes.description: Represents a grid structure similar to Form, allowing inclusion of grid layouts, with expansion attributes.

classes.name: Tree
classes.description: Includes a tree widget, allowing rendering of hierarchical structures with location, name, and scope expansion.

classes.name: PlatformSpecific
classes.description: Contains platform-specific sub-widgets supporting different rendering types like HTML, XSL-FO, XML, Text, CSV, XLS.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Represents content blocks, supporting dynamic content ID, data resource, edit controls, and rendering logic for content display.

classes.name: SubContent
classes.description: Represents a sub-content widget that includes dynamic content such as associated resource, mappings, and editing options, with rendering logic and XML escape control.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Represents an included menu component with expansion of name and location attributes, responsible for rendering menus within the UI.

classes.name: ScreenLink
classes.description: Defines a link widget with properties for URL, target, style, associated images, parameters, and rendering logic for hyperlinks.

classes.name: ScreenImage
classes.description: Represents an image widget with attributes for source URL, size, border, alternate text, and rendering methods.

classes.name: PortalPage
classes.description: Encapsulates a portal page component, including dynamic ID, configuration mode, and private access flag; manages rendering of portal columns and portlets with hierarchical content expansion.
